answer.reason: The "section of picture tiles" is most likely the Bento Section component (BentoSection), whose description says it is "a great way to showcase some screenshots or graphics." Its tiles are items of the BentoCard content model (Bento Card, a content list). Each card has Eyebrow, Title, Description, and a Graphic image field, which suits a tile with a large product screenshot. The alternative, GalleryImage (used by the Gallery "Images" grid), holds only an image and a caption, so it fits a plain picture grid better than a tile that needs a title and description. I did not save anything.
